rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an outer jacket worn over other clothes.

example.english: It’s very cold today, so I need to put on a jacket.
example.traditional: 今日好凍，我要著返件外套。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 faan1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the jacket belonging to a suit.

example.english: I’m seeing a client tomorrow, so I have to wear a suit jacket.
example.traditional: 聽日見客，我要著西裝褸先得。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 gin3 haak3 ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 sai1 zong1 lau1 sin1 dak1

rows.note: Use this for a life jacket rather than a clothing jacket.

example.english: Remember to put on your life jacket before getting in the water.
example.traditional: 落水之前記住著好救生衣。
example.jyutping: lok6 seoi2 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 zoek3 hou2 gau3 sang1 ji1

rows.note: Use this for a file jacket or folder that holds documents.

example.english: This contract should go in the file jacket.
example.traditional: 呢份合約要放入文件夾。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jiu3 fong3 jap6 man4 gin2 gaap3
